findings.issue: The M-sized incident package still spans two independently released contours: the in-container scheduler/review race and the default-branch GitHub Actions watcher.
findings.why_matters: The combined scope remains feasible in one iteration and needs no migration or new dependency, but the two contours have different test seams, rollback paths and activation moments.
findings.fix: Keep the shared user-spec, but decompose implementation and verification into separate scheduler and watcher tasks/commits so either contour can be reviewed or rolled back independently.

summary: Approved: the proposal is feasible with the current Python/SQLite/GitHub Actions stack and is a credible high-M iteration. The previous major findings are resolved: implementation HOW has moved out of the user-spec, and future MM-DD evidence now has an explicit conservative rule (only Dec-to-Jan rolls back a year; every other future suffix is inconclusive).
